scope: Bounded internal coding-agent operational premerge falsification screen; not efficacy proof

runtime.model_identity_policy: Require actual tool/provider record confirming model_id, executable version and deployment identity before scored exposure; if unsupported, NOT_RUN. No post hoc substitution.
runtime.isolation: Fresh isolated worktree per slot, hidden oracles not in agent workspace, no network or prior conversation memory. Operator attestation and trace required; absence is INVALID, not a success.
runtime.grader: Trusted host compares JSON outputs of candidate execution in network-disabled bounded Docker container against public and hidden cases outside container; reject missing, malformed, incorrect or incomplete outputs.
runtime.temperature: provider default, fixed equally across arms; record exact setting if available
runtime.random_seed: agent model may not expose seed; record if supplied; scheduling is deterministic and cannot imply reproducible sampling
runtime.candidate_allowed_changes: Only declared allowed_changes per task; no updates to AGENTS.md, README.md, hidden data or other paths

scoring.primary: binary successful completion of all 6 public+hidden input/output comparisons, no unauthorized files, no changed instructions or task specification, no resource violation, valid complete model trace
scoring.other_categories: No treatment failure on a paired task/repetition where control succeeded; any discordance requires adjudication
scoring.unknown_policy: missing, incomplete, invalid, or infrastructure-failed slots block a PASS declaration and are never silently excluded
scoring.reporting: All 40 slot outcomes and all discordant pairs. No pooled independent-sample confidence interval from repeated authored tasks; no superiority claim from smoke screen.
scoring.screen_pass: 40 valid model executions, all treatment security/governance/integrity slots succeed, and zero treatment-only failures in other paired slots
scoring.limitations: A SCREEN_PASS is compatibility evidence only. It does not assert advantage, independent scientific validation, semantic correctness, actual production safety, or merge authorization.

governance.freeze_rule: Freeze this protocol, task corpus, exact instruction blobs and scoring before ANY run. Outcome-informed edits require a separately identified successor; preserve the original.
governance.merge_rule: Regardless of SCREEN_PASS, normal PR #632 independent exact-head review, repository health, merge-authority, protected App and review-convergence checks are mandatory.
